newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore awards land tender for S$682.8 million.
newsitem.headline: Singapore awards land tender for S$682.8 million.

text.p: A 39,702 square metre land parcel has been awarded to Japura Pte Ltd for a tendered sale price of Singapore $682.8 million, Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Tuesday.
The URA said the parcel on Singapore's East Coast was for development of a condominium.
Based on the tendered land price and the permissible gross floor area of 138,956 sq metres, the price per square metre was S$4,914, it said.
Another 21,381 sq metre site for mixed landed housing was sold to Goodland Pte Ltd for $17.95 million, the URA said.
